meta_description: Gray's Ground Maintenance provides expert gardening and ground care across Nottingham. Professional landscaping, lawn treatment, and seasonal maintenance. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Ground Care — Serving Nottingham Since 2010
hero_subhead: From overgrown lawns to seasonal borders, Gray's handles the hard graft so your garden thrives year-round.
services_heading: Complete Ground Maintenance Services for Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether it's routine lawn care, seasonal tidy-ups, or a full garden transformation, we've got you covered.

services.title: Regular Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cutting, edging, and seasonal feeding to keep your grass healthy and even. We adjust height and frequency to suit your garden and the weather.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Overgrown borders, old sheds, tangled weeds — we clear the lot and haul away the waste. Perfect for starting fresh or preparing for landscaping.

services.title: Hedge and Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Expert shaping and pruning of hedges, conifers, and shrubs to keep them tidy and vigorous. Tidy lines or natural shapes — your choice.

services.title: Seasonal Border Work
services.desc: Spring planting, summer deadheading, autumn leaf clearance, and winter preparation. We keep your beds looking fresh all year.

services.title: Patio and Pathway Cleaning
services.desc: High-pressure cleaning removes algae, moss, and dirt from patios, drives, and paths. Safer than DIY and gets results in one visit.

services.title: Garden Design Advice
services.desc: Struggling to plan a overhaul? We offer practical suggestions for layout, planting, and materials to suit your budget and style.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hate seeing gardens go to waste — there's always a solution.
about_para_1: Gray's Ground Maintenance was founded on a simple idea: a well-kept garden makes a home. For over 15 years, we've been helping Nottingham homeowners and landlords transform neglected outdoor spaces into places they actually enjoy. We're not fancy — just reliable, fair-priced, and committed to turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, doing the job properly, and treating your garden like it matters. Lots of our customers have been with us for years — they know we listen, we work hard, and we don't overcharge. If your garden needs help, give us a ring.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Gray's

reviews.text: Had my garden completely overgrown when I moved in — absolute state. Gray's cleared it in a day, disposed of everything properly, and even offered ideas for what to plant next. Brilliant bloke, very fair price. Already booked him for monthly maintenance.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Gray's for two years now for fortnightly lawn cuts. Never misses a slot, always turns up on time, and the garden looks immaculate. Tried other gardeners before — he's in a different league. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Needed my patio cleaned before a family get-together. Called Gray's on a Friday, he was round Saturday morning with his pressure washer, and it looked brand new. Quick, professional, and reasonably priced. Top-notch service.
reviews.author: David K.

address_sub: Serving Nottingham and within 5 miles of Wilford
opening_hours_sub: Sat: 9am – 1pm • Emergency hedge work by arrangement
emergency_banner_text: Garden emergency or urgent tidy-up needed? We'll do our best to fit you in. Call now —
